extracted.name: French crêpes
extracted.description: Try our foolproof recipe that will ensure a perfectly golden stack of crêpes. Enjoy as a treat, or turn them into our impressive cherry Bakewell crêpe cake
ingredient_lines: 80g unsalted melted butter plus extra for frying
instruction_lines: Sift the flour into a large bowl, add the sugar and a pinch of salt, then stir to combine. Make a well in the middle, pour in the egg and begin whisking from the centre. Slowly pour in the milk and cream, whisking constantly until you have a smooth batter. If you have time, rest for at least 1 hr for best results. Stir in the melted butter.

Heat a 16cm frying pan over a medium heat, then brush the pan with butter using folded kitchen paper or a pastry brush. Add a small ladleful of batter to the pan, immediately swirling it around so it spreads to the edge in a neat circle. Cook for 1-2 mins, or until just set and lightly golden, then flip and cook on the other side for 1 min. Set aside on a plate and repeat until you’ve used up all of the batter.
